removes.rationale: The tactical tanker thesis was entered on tightening reroute/oil-reserve dynamics, but by quarter-end the dominant driver has flipped to soft, structural Chinese crude demand pulling VLCC rates toward multi-year seasonal lows — a fundamental breach of the 'tighten' framing that justified a tactical (not core) position.

news_evidence.summary: "Weight of Freight: VLCC rally hits a snag with weak Chinese demand" — ship operators' hopes for a continued summer rate rally dashed by sluggish Chinese crude demand
DHT Holdings management flags Chinese economic growth and oil demand running slower than expected, weighing on VLCC rates

rationale_overall: Net effect: swap a weakening tactical commodity-cycle position (FRO, whose 'tighten' thesis is breaching as Chinese demand softens) for a first foothold in the robotics wave (TER), the user's explicitly named #2 next-wave that had zero dedicated exposure. All other current holdings show continued buildup-phase evidence: RKLB (Archimedes engine hot-fire at Stennis), IONQ (ARLIS DoD contract Aug 6, $54.5M USAF award Sept 27), ASTS (Block 1 BlueBird satellites launched Sept 12, direct-to-cell field tests), LUNR (NASA CLPS south-pole award, Near Space Network contract), OKLO (Equinix 500MW LOI plus $25M prepayment, DOE fuel-facility design approval), WELL (record occupancy growth, raised 2024 guidance), and ITA/defense (fastest spending growth in four decades). MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA/SPY remain the AI-wave and market core. Watchlist stays at the 12-ticker cap.
